title: Additions
description: a Vanilla+ mod that add plenty of new things
body:
Additions is a Vanilla+ mod that aimed to add things that does not break the spirit of Minecraft. 

This mod is in his early stage ! // Everything may not work as intended.


This mod include :
- Decorative blocks
- Plants
- Tools

 • Candle Lantern: Hanging / On floor | Lit / No flame
 ![Candle Lantern: Hanging / On floor | Lit / No flame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07d74d482f03aafd21ca0267b8a9f60093739adf.png)

 • Jars: Empty / Honey / Water / Milk
 ![Jars: Empty / Honey / Water / Milk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/450c8a04605943024e6da7a86b874835d20ff117.png)
